name: johng.io
background: Handcrafted my portfolio site with GatsbyJS and React. At build time, the site fetches public repository data from the GitHub GraphQL API, transforms it in Gatsby's GraphQL data layer, and validates it with Zod to ensure correctness. It uses custom daisyUI components styled with Tailwind CSS to present a selection of projects, contact options, and other Markdown content on the homepage. A GitHub Actions workflow builds the GitHub Pages site on a weekly basis to integrate the latest changes.
